## UI polish: Khmer welcome card 8 fixes across Typography, Spacing, Hierarchy, States, Layout, Motion and Tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from the pasted tokens. ### Fixes 1. **Typography**: Khmer text had `letter-spacing: -0.02em` on the heading and line-heights of 1.2 and 1.5. Now `letter-spacing: 0` and `line-height: var(--line-height-khmer)` on both. The `:lang(km)` block in your tokens would not win here, because the `.k h2` and `.k p` selectors are more specific. (R-ui-polish-35) 2. **Tokens**: raw type values now use their tokens. The `h2` font size `24px` is `var(--font-size-2xl)`. The `p` font size `16px` is `var(--font-size-md)`. `font-family: system-ui` is `var(--font-family-sans)`. The heading's default bold is `font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)`. The paragraph has `max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-20, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-8) 3. **Spacing**: `padding: 16px` is now `var(--card-padding)`. `margin: 0 0 8px` is now `0 0 var(--space-8)`. `margin: 0 0 16px` is now `0 0 var(--space-16)`. The button `padding: 8px 16px` is now `var(--space-8) var(--space-16)`. The two buttons had no set gap, so `.k button + button` now has `margin-inline-start: var(--space-8)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Hierarchy**: "រក្សាទុក" is the one primary action, filled with `var(--button-primary-bg)` and `var(--button-primary-text)`. "បោះបង់" is secondary: transparent background, `var(--button-secondary-text)` text and a `var(--button-secondary-border)` border. Both use `var(--button-radius)`. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 5. **Layout**: `min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px` is now `var(--size-target-min)` on both buttons. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **States**: added hover, pressed, `:focus-visible` and disabled styles. Hover uses `var(--button-primary-bg-hover)` on primary and `var(--color-selected-bg)` on secondary. Pressed uses `var(--button-primary-bg-pressed)`. Focus is `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus)` with a 2px offset. Disabled is `opacity: 0.5` and `cursor: not-allowed`. (R-ui-polish-6) 7. **Motion**: added `transition: background-color var(--duration-base) var(--ease-standard)` on buttons so the hover change eases in. It is turned off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. (R-ui-polish-9) 8. **Tokens**: text and button colours now come from `--button-*` and `--color-*` variables instead of browser defaults. (R-ui-polish-20, R-ui-polish-32) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Primary button label | browser default button | `--button-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--button-primary-bg` (#0f766e), 5.47:1 | | Primary button label, hover and pressed | none | `--button-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--button-primary-bg-hover` (#0c403c), 11.58:1 | | Secondary button label | browser default button | `--button-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 5.47:1 | | Secondary button label, hover | none | `--button-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-selected-bg` (#f0fdfc), 5.26:1 | | Heading and paragraph | inherited browser text colour, kept | unchanged, see Open questions | Ratios computed by hand with the formula; run the contrast script to confirm them. The contrast script could not run here: the command needed approval and was not allowed. ### Polished code ```html

សូមស្វាគមន៍

សូមពិនិត្យព័ត៌មានរបស់អ្នក

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: `--color-brand` (#0f766e) and the primary scale. - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - Drift: the buttons use 16px horizontal padding (`--space-16`), but `--button-padding-x` is 12px. 16px passes, so it is kept as written. Say if the token should win. - Drift: heading and paragraph inherit the browser's black text (21.00:1). `--color-text-default` is #202d2c (14.25:1, by hand). The black passes, so it is kept; say if the token should win. - Your `design/tokens.css` is assumed to be loaded by the page, since you pasted it for this polish. If it is not, none of the `var(--…)` values will resolve.
